newsitem.title: USA: Report says Motorola rivals gain in US sales - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Report says Motorola rivals gain in US sales - WSJ.

text.p: The latest results from an industry research group show that Motorola is losing sales to rivals in the U.S. digital telephone business, the Wall Street Journal said Tuesday.
The results from Dataquest Inc, scheduled to be released today, show early winners in the digital phone battle to be Sweden's Telefon AB L.M. Ericcson and Finland's Oy Nokia, the report said.

The paper said Ericcson had nearly a threefold increase in the number of phones it sold last year, and Nokia's sales doubled. However Motorola posted a 62 percent drop to 117,000 units from 1995's top spot of 305,000 units, the report said.
A Motorola spokesman told the paper that the market shares shown in the Dataquest report were "ludicrous" and that the company matched the 300,000-unit level last year.
